_comment: Hidden coordinator oracle. Grade finding entities/severity and semantic observations against actual execution; never expose to runners.

observations: Approved profile brand_terms and explicit nonbrand role are used, not inferred account naming.
Observed brand query acme cordless drill has 40 clicks against 3400 campaign clicks, approximately 1.18%, not more than 5%.
Mixed keyword inventory alone is not a Critical defect; query reporting coverage is partial.
Ad group 2005 has two coherent angle-grinder keywords; count alone is not a defect.
Group 2003 contains 35 keywords with varied product themes; generic power-tool copy is not confirmed support for garden/ladder themes.
Themes and message evidence are assessed without claiming keyword count or QS caused performance.
Free cordless drill has 130 EUR mature zero-conversion exposure, and free product requests are explicitly business-excluded.
Low CTR and generic how-to/research terms are not automatic exclusion reasons; converting desired queries are protected.
Proposed scope and match type are reviewed against positive and negative inventory; exposure is not guaranteed savings.
Search-only scope separates Shopping and PMax and preserves unsupported metrics as unavailable.
Campaign1002 budget-lost share25% and campaign1003 rank-lost share35% are descriptive observations, not automatically Critical.
Meeting a CPA goal is not proof of profit and lost impressions are not guaranteed recoverable conversions.
Achieved CPA is 50 and tCPA30 gives positive restrictiveness 0.40; achieved ROAS5 and tROAS3 gives negative restrictiveness -0.40.
ROAS-RELAXED is a less restrictive return target, not an unrealistic tighter target.
Missing history blocks historical regime/trend claims, not the explicitly allowed snapshot-versus-aggregate comparison.
Both members spend3000 and have50% spend share in a stable complete two-member regime.
Raw HHI is0.50, equal-share baseline0.50 and normalized concentration0.
No starvation or split recommendation is justified by concentration alone; no response model exists.
Phrase negative buy red shoes blocks literal K2 buy red shoes.
It does not block literal K1 red shoes by reverse containment, nor K3 shoes red by unordered phrase matching.
A literal query block does not prove complete suppression of a positive phrase/broad keyword.
CTR is100/10000=1%; video view rate is3000/10000=30%; viewability is6000/8000=75%.
No low-view-rate finding is produced from the1% CTR.
No account-level exclusions is not itself a defect.
Three Acme alternatives pinned to H1 in VALID-PINS are valid alternatives and preserve the Acme requirement.
OPTIONAL-ONLY places Terms apply only in H3, so the required message is not guaranteed in shorter renderings.
No blanket remove-all-pins or high-pin-count defect is proposed.
The complete ad-group inventory includes G-EMPTY with zero RSAs and G-ADS with two.
Two ordinary RSAs and performance differences do not establish random assignment or a statistical winner.
Experiment inference is unavailable without experiment plan/results; inventory still runs.
VALID-ADVANCED denied-state cookieless pings without cookies/identifiers match the supplied design and are not a defect merely because they fire pre-consent.
BAD-STORAGE traces repeatedly show prohibited cookies/identifiers under denied states and must be identified as a technical-policy mismatch.
No legal-compliance certification is issued; optional modeling diagnostics do not block trace analysis.
WEB-ACTION Web settings are enabled and corroborated by Web diagnostics/traces, independent of the disabled Leads flag.
Email-only supported capture with phone/name absent is not automatically a defect.
Consent denied traces do not authorize enhancement transmission; no identifier values are requested.
Normal baseline has10% CVR, sale15%, and post-event10%.
The33.33% decline from sale is a return to normal; relative to normal the post-event change is0%.
No routine negative adjustment is recommended in the absence of an exceptional future below-normal event.
PROMO-TITLE contains Black Friday Deal promotion text and needs a truthful-descriptor correction, not more promotional keywords.
TRUE-DESCRIPTOR Christmas-pattern is a documented genuine product attribute and need not be removed or receive a gift prefix.
No query-to-product opportunity is fabricated from the missing optional mapping.
Native historical daily QS is used directly without requiring external snapshot scripts.
The same criterion QK changes from8 to5 with explicit component changes; current-state metrics are not substituted for history.
No deterministic CPC savings or mandatory restructure is claimed from the QS change.
Five conversions and50 clicks do not make the action ineligible for DDA.
Every counting for distinct leads and unit values under count-based optimization are explicit intended settings, not default defects.
FAST-AFTER-LONG-SALE has0.5-hour queue delay and0.5-hour processing despite its30-day sales cycle.
QUEUED-3-DAYS has72-hour queue delay, exceeding the2-hour SLA, with1-hour processing.
Click-to-conversion/sales-cycle lag is not upload-processing delay; two distinct accepted outcomes are not inflated by attempts.
An Ads product-performance sample cannot establish missing GTIN/brand or whole-catalog completeness.
Merchant feed, diagnostics and requirement/reference evidence are missing; assessment is partial/incomplete, not a clean pass or an invented attribute defect.
Search and PMax aggregate outcome differences do not establish causal cannibalization.
PMax brand share/query overlap is unmeasurable without PMax query evidence; no automatic brand exclusion follows.
Available aggregate inventory remains descriptive while missing time series/controls/tests are clearly named.
CONTROL has descriptive CPA50 and VARIANT25 from1400/28 and1400/56.
Arm daily totals do not provide assignment-unit variance/covariance or method-backed confidence intervals; without experiment_inference no winner is declared.
Linked portfolio tCPA100 takes precedence over profile20 when the campaign has no embedded target.
K-CPA150 achieved CPA150 from3000/20 does not cross the2x applicable target200 screen; no high-CPA Warning should arise from the profile target40 screen.
The portfolio target also governs the required spend_floor: EUR100, not the EUR50 profile-based fallback; unused money thresholds need not be computed.
503 at10:00 followed by200 at10:05 does not prove uninterrupted failure between probes.
EUR1440 daily cost is not evidenced incident-window cost, and uniform prorating toEUR5 is not observed spend.
The partial-overlap daily amount can be at most a clearly labeled upper bound on potentially affected exposure; no guaranteed savings are claimed.
Daily top prominence90% then60% and native share80% then40% are distinct reported daily series.
Without native weekly reports or compatible denominator weights, no weekly aggregate rate/share is calculated using campaign impressions or arithmetic averages.
Descriptive daily evidence still runs; weekly aggregates are explicitly unavailable rather than a clean pass.
M1/REUSED-ID identifies two feed variants: IT/it andFR/fr.
The descriptor and query mapping omit feed_label/language, so they cannot be uniquely attributed to either product variant.
The singleEUR100 query row is not duplicated intoEUR200, and no locale-specific Christmas-pattern title change is justified.
